$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/portal-frame.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). W2b schema wave 20/22 (B-W2b-156). The office (factory_runtime; the worker and scheduler in the tenant's system scope) opens, reminds, closes, reopens and cancels partner tasks in the commands that make and answer their requests, and reads every partner's e-mail settings (the notification fan-out and the digest read them; the unsubscribe link of a mail changes one). Portal and link sessions run as factory_partner_runtime behind their party's wall (scopedBy party): they read their own party's tasks, never who in the office asked (askedById hidden; askedByName is the name they see), and close an OPEN one as DONE in the command that answers it; a portal session reads and saves its people's e-mail settings (the first visit, E-mail settings). The …_portal_frame_w2b_guards triggers hold each partner write to that, and keep a setting to a person of its party. No floor grant: none of this is floor work. No money column. Nothing is deleted: a task is cancelled, a setting changed. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

PartnerTask.about: The office's commands open a task with the request they make of a partner, move its due time, mark when it was reminded, close it as DONE or CANCELLED and reopen it; Home, the rail badges and the reminder mails read the same list. A portal or link session reads its own party's tasks and closes an OPEN one as DONE in the command that answers it (the guard lets it change nothing else); never who in the office asked.

PartnerEmailPreference.about: A portal session saves its person's e-mail settings, one row per topic (the first visit, then E-mail settings), and reads its party's; the office reads them for the fan-out and the digests, and changes one from a mail's unsubscribe link. The guard keeps each row to a partner user of its party; the person, the party and the topic never change. Personal data: the person's own choice (purpose: the portal account and the consent to non-essential mail).
